canonical_inventory_format: UTF-8/LF; ordinal relative-POSIX-path sorting; each line SHA256 SPACE decimal-byte-size SPACE relative-path LF.

policy.credential_scan: High-confidence private-key/token/credential-URI patterns; documented synthetic fixture exception; not a universal secret guarantee.
policy.evidence_self_reference: Ledger and overlay included. Manifest/checksums/verification separately controlled to avoid circular hashes.
policy.untracked_files: Explicitly listed, reviewed and hashed; no staging/commit performed.

qualification: Exact local source snapshot only, not gameplay/device/build/deployment acceptance; no signature or external trust anchor.
